name: What kind of equipment do you use for sewage cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What kind of equipment do you use for sewage cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: For sewage cleanup, we utilize specialized equipment designed for hazardous waste remediation. This includes powerful industrial-grade extractors for water removal, air scrubbers and negative air machines to purify the air and contain airborne contaminants, and commercial-grade dehumidifiers and air movers for thorough drying. We also use professional-strength disinfectants and antimicrobial agents to sanitize affected surfaces and prevent mold and bacterial growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: We use industrial-grade extractors, air scrubbers, dehumidifiers, air movers, and professional disinfectants for effective sewage cleanup.
